one_line: Sangam-age Chola chief of Tamilakam, a bow-bearing war leader of the Kaveri plains.

appearance.age_look: mid-30s, athletic and wiry, with a seasoned warrior’s build
appearance.face: oval face with strong cheekbones, medium-brown Tamil complexion, straight nose, sharp black eyes with thick brows, a trimmed moustache, and a calm but intense default expression suggesting tactical focus
appearance.hair: thick black hair pulled into a high, narrow topknot at the crown, sides neatly combed back, secured with a simple bronze hair ring; no crown, only a plain dark red cloth band tied around the forehead as a sweatband
appearance.costume: sleeveless dark indigo cotton tunic reaching mid-thigh, worn over a tight short-sleeved inner vest; lower body wrapped in a deep maroon cotton veshti/dhoti tied firmly at the waist and falling to the ankles with a slight front pleat, bare feet in simple brown leather sandals; a narrow ochre cotton angavastram draped from left shoulder across chest and tucked at the right hip; bronze armlets on both biceps, a single flat bronze torque at the neck, small round bronze earrings, and a simple palm-leaf waist belt for utility; textiles plain-weave with subtle border stripes at hem, no royal finery or embroidery.
appearance.signature: a long, slightly recurved wooden bow held in his left hand, dark polished wood with simple bronze-capped tips, accompanied by a plain leather quiver at his back filled with reed arrows with feather fletching; this bow is his constant emblem of martial authority.

ref_desc: Karikala Chola is a mid-30s medium-brown Tamil warrior with a high black topknot, indigo tunic, maroon veshti, ochre shoulder cloth, bronze ornaments, leather sandals, and a long recurved wooden bow with a back quiver in deep maroon, dark indigo and ochre tones.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body shonen-anime style Tamil warrior chief from the Sangam age: mid-30s, medium-brown complexion, oval face with strong cheekbones, sharp black eyes, trimmed moustache, and a calm intense expression. His thick black hair is pulled into a high topknot at the crown, held with a simple bronze ring and a dark red cloth band tied around his forehead. He wears a sleeveless dark indigo cotton tunic over a tight short-sleeved inner vest, a deep maroon cotton veshti/dhoti wrapped firmly to the ankles with a front pleat, and an ochre angavastram draped from the left shoulder across the chest and tucked at the right hip. Add bronze armlets on both biceps, a flat bronze torque at the neck, small round bronze earrings, a simple palm-leaf waist belt, and plain brown leather sandals; keep all textiles plain-weave with subtle border stripes, no fancy embroidery. His signature weapon is a long, slightly recurved dark wooden bow held in his left hand, with bronze-capped tips and a plain leather back quiver full of reed arrows with feather fletching. Use deep maroon, dark indigo, ochre, bronze and medium-brown skin tones as the dominant colours, and present him front-facing in a neutral stance suitable for a character model sheet.
